caption: The drawing depicts two architectural ornaments resembling fantastical sea creatures or dragons, both with spiral, shell-like bodies and numerous spiky protrusions along their backs and heads. Both figures are rendered in shades of brown and reddish-brown, with highlights and shading giving a three-dimensional appearance. The larger ornament occupies the right and central portion of the image, positioned atop a rectangular stone pedestal, and extends upward with a wide-open mouth gripping a cylindrical rod or pipe. The smaller ornament, located to the lower left, is similar in form and also holds a cylindrical rod in its mouth, but is less detailed and appears to be further in the background. Both ornaments sit on stepped, beige stone platforms, and the background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a light tan or off-white color. The composition is arranged with strong diagonals formed by the rods and the spiral forms of the creatures.
title: Iron Fence - Sea Horse Design
